 Follow ‘Ginny & Georgia’ Sets Season 4 Release Date, Drops First Look Photos
 Tanya Fedak Wed, November 18, 2026 at 6:53 PM UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. "Ginny & Georgia" is officially returning to Netflix with a fourth season, promising a series of even more secrets that threaten to be uncovered.
 Set to release Jan. 21, Season 4 begins with Georgia Miller (Brianne Howey) having dodged a murder charge, and "life is finally back to normal," per the official description. "Except that the Millers are broke again. And Georgia's pregnant and doesn't know who the father is. And strange things keep happening, hinting that maybe Georgia's past isn't willing to stay buried. Ginny (Antonia Gentry) is desperate to break the cycle of chaos, and Georgia is desperate to prove to her kids that she can. And as for Austin… well… This season it's him against the world. The family is at a turning point. But when push comes to shove, will the Millers be able to start fresh? Or will the past pull them back in?"

 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Starring alongside Howey and Gentry in the fourth season are Felix Mallard, Sara Waisglass, Scott Porter, Diesel La Torraca, Jennifer Robertson, Raymond Ablack, Katie Douglas, Chelsea Clark and Nathan Mitchell. Joining the series are Ali Skovbye ("Whistle"), Kataem O'Connor ("40 Acres," "Murdoch Mysteries") and Sunny Mabrey ("Cape Fear," "The Night Agent").
 "Ginny & Georgia" is created by Sarah Lampert, who also serves as co-showrunner and executive producer alongside Sarah Glinski. Jenny Daly, Jeff Tahler, Holly Hines, Daniel March (Dynamic Television), David Monahan, Danielle Hoover, Ali Kinney and Lance Samuels and Daniel Iron (Blue Ice Pictures) serve as executive producers.
